_comment: First-run level config for a user who has never saved one (dashboard/app.py::_seed). NOT an overlay — once a dashboard_prefs row exists it is the whole truth, so an override the user clears stays cleared. `level` is SPARSE: it lists only the event types whose lane differs from the one their derivation depth implies; every other type gets its lane from depth at render time (web/src/view.ts::defaultLevelOf). `hidden` lists types kept off the timeline at every altitude. credit_card_payment is the canonical override — D1, zero inference, and still one of the most interesting things in a day.
